note: Every idea or choice adopted in this project, with its origin. researched = survived a logged prior-art search; reach-synthesis = synthesised from other sources, not yet checked against prior art; serendipitous = arose by accident. Seeded 2026-10-31 by the hub; most entries are reach-synthesis because the research rule was adopted after they were made. See AGENTS.md, 'Standing order: every new idea is researched'.

ideas.idea: Describe organism generation as levels of completeness: 0 topology, 1 expression, 2 quantities, 3 regulation, 4 development, 5 function.
sources: the hub's synthesis from the phiX174, JCVI-syn3.0 and whole-cell-model cases, not independently checked

research.finding: No prior levels framework found in six searches. Nearest existing vocabulary: Karr 2015's unordered completeness dimensions for a single cell (10.1016/j.mib.2015.06.004). Physiome organises by spatial scale, which matches our layers, not our levels.

ideas.presentation: Present as DELPHI's own scheme and cite Karr 2015 as the closest vocabulary.

ideas.idea: Genotype-phenotype links propagate along part_of by type: 'expressed in' may go up, 'required for' never goes down, upward chains of 'required for' are marked derived.
sources: the hub's synthesis from ontology-reasoning practice; whether Monarch or Phenoscape already state such rules is under research

research.finding: The search found Monarch, uPheno and Phenoscape doing cross-species genotype-to-phenotype reasoning with OWL; it did not report on propagation rules specifically. Still reach-synthesis until checked against those projects' documented reasoning. Genotype thread PubMed check (genotype/cache/pubmed_propagation.json, 4 queries, 4 abstracts incl. uPheno 10.1093/genetics/iyaf027) found no abstract documenting part_of propagation of phenotypes; Phenoscape and Monarch full text not checked.

ideas.idea: Use medaka (same order, Beloniformes) and zebrafish as labelled proxy species for flying-fish molecular data.
sources: measured: OrthoDB holds zero Belonoidei genomes and NCBI one scaffold-level Exocoetidae assembly (dashboard/figures/DATA.md)
the choice of proxy is synthesis
alternatives_rejected: presenting zebrafish data as flying-fish data
waiting for flying-fish expression data that does not exist

ideas.idea: Use machine-checked theorems to eliminate candidate answers to open problems (never the problems themselves), with three states: eliminated, consistent, cannot rule.
sources: the enzyme side project's blocked-route certificates
Galileo's square-cube argument as the model case

ideas.idea: Test formal proofs by mutating the theorem STATEMENT, not the proof, and requiring the mutant to fail to compile.
sources: the Lean thread's practice, building on mutation testing in software engineering

ideas.idea: Compare verdicts on claims tested independently by two agent swarms, and diagnose every disagreement.
sources: the overlap was unplanned: 8 claims had been tested by both this project's swarm and the collaborator's
ideas.evidence: dashboard/public/crosscheck.json: 6 of 8 agree; both disagreements traced to a pre-registration choice

ideas.idea: Check every fossil first-appearance date against the single occurrence driving it.
sources: noticed because a figure showed flies at 390 Ma
ideas.evidence: dashboard/figures/DATA.md: three of twelve PBDB dates were errors, two of them genus-name homonyms

ideas.idea: Do not declare a nanopub template a record cannot genuinely instantiate; the published Delphi templates use a retired namespace.
sources: found by the organism thread's conformance checker

ideas.idea: What distinguishes a flying fish is fin size and proportion, and zebrafish long-fin phenotypes have been attributed to potassium-channel genes.
sources: the hub's recollection, explicitly unverified; the genotype agent was told to verify through ZFIN, PubMed or OpenResearch before using it

research.finding: Verified: Daane et al. 2021 (10.1016/j.cub.2021.08.054) report that lat4a together with kcnh2a reproduces flying-fish fin proportions in zebrafish.

ideas.idea: A physics thread scoped to the levels the flying fish lacks: Level 2 (quantities: fin size and proportion) and Level 5 (function: gliding), by taking unowned issues #50 (glide data) and #43 (Thompson's flight envelope), and formalising the scaling relations in Lean including strength proportional to L^2.
sources: the levels-of-completeness frame (itself reach-synthesis, under research)
the open-problems ledger: 17 candidates cannot be ruled on without strength ~ L^2

research.note: the thread must run a logged prior-art search on flying-fish aerodynamics before modelling

alternatives_rejected: a general physics engine (no data to validate it against)
a form simulator (issue #54, owned by Kris)
running it as a background agent rather than a named session (the project lead chose a session)

ideas.idea: Say 'fin enlargement for gliding', not 'fin-to-wing transition'. A flying fish's 'wing' is an enlarged pectoral fin, not a fin-to-limb homology; Phenoscape's fin-to-limb work concerns lobe-finned fishes.
alternatives_rejected: 'fin-to-wing transition', which a reader would take in the fin-to-limb homology sense

ideas.idea: State novelty only as: 'we did not find prior use of a proof assistant on an ontology-derived anatomy hierarchy'. Never 'the first formal verification of biology' - Lean has been applied to the genetic code (10.48550/arxiv.2610.36343) and K-Lean exists.

research.note: Google Scholar, GitHub, arXiv full text and industry work were not searched, so even the narrow claim is 'not found', not 'does not exist'.

ideas.idea: Bgee 15.2 and ZFIN ensembl_1_to_1 use different Ensembl releases; a Bgee gene with no 1:1 row is merged onto the ZFIN gene with the identical symbol (1,614 merges), else kept under its Ensembl id.
alternatives_rejected: keeping both keys (double counts fgf10a, shha)

ideas.idea: Keep a ZFIN phenotype row only when every experiment it matches is ZECO:0000103 standard conditions.
alternatives_rejected: trusting the clean file name (102 uniquely non-standard and 2,914 ambiguous rows in it)

ideas.idea: Every required-for link carries a loss-of-function evidence class (knockdown; truncating allele; recessive allele, presumed); a homozygous allele that also shows a heterozygous phenotype and has no truncating consequence is rejected as possible gain of function. Required-for links 10,544 to 10,042.
sources: Perathoner 2014 (alf kcnk5b is dominant gain-of-function missense)
alternatives_rejected: dropping all alleles without a recorded consequence (loses 9,637 rows of classical recessive mutants)
keeping dominant alleles with a flag (would present possible GOF as LOF)

research.finding: NCBI Gene 124935 (human SLC43A2, alias LAT4) and 393221 (zebrafish slc43a2a); ZFIN curated the Daane paper (ZDB-PUB-210918-31, PMID 34534441) to slc43a2a: 6 phenotype rows, allele dmh26, pectoral and caudal fin decreased length.
